name: mdz-cli
description: CLI tool for working with MDZ (Markdown Zipped Container) files; reads legacy .mdx archives too

scripts.build:all: bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/mdz-win-x64.exe && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/mdz-macos-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/mdz-macos-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/index.ts --outfile dist/mdz-linux-x64
